## Key takeaways

• Seller Assistant now carries persistent memory of each seller’s business, delivering personal recommendations on topics like inventory management and pricing that sharpen over time.

• New Seller Assistant workflows give sellers the power to continuously monitor and execute routine tasks like restocking and pricing adjustments with full audit trails and seller-defined guardrails.

• A new plugin brings Seller Assistant’s intelligence into the AI tools sellers already use, launching first with Amazon Quick and in beta with Anthropic's Claude—with a free 12-month Quick Plus subscription to help them run their business on and off Amazon.

## Amazon introduces agentic AI across the seller experience, transforming how sellers manage their businesses

Powered by Amazon Bedrock, Seller Assistant evolves into an always-on, agentic AI-powered partner that helps sellers launch, manage, and grow their business.

## A smarter Seller Assistant that works across a seller’s entire business

## Amazon sellers can now automatically improve product listings with our new Gen AI tool

Leveraging Gen AI learnings, Amazon is empowering sellers with new Enhance My Listing tool to make listing optimization effortless and effective.

## Seller Assistant workflows that work around the clock

## Bringing Seller Assistant’s intelligence to the AI tools sellers already use

## It’s now easier for sellers to manage their money on Amazon

Amazon Seller Wallet gives selling partners more control over how much and when to convert their funds—available in USD and in EUR.

## A record number of independent sellers in Amazon’s store surpassed $1 million in sales in 2025

A new Amazon report shows independent sellers thrived in 2025, reflecting the resilience of small businesses.

ar_body:
أعلنت Amazon عن نقلة في Seller Assistant ليصبح شريكاً ذكياً يعمل دائماً لمساعدة البائعين على إطلاق أعمالهم وإدارتها.

• ذاكرة دائمة لكل بائع تقدم توصيات شخصية في المخزون والتسعير وتتحسن مع الوقت.
• سير عمل جديد يراقب وينفذ مهاماً روتينية مثل إعادة التخزين وتعديل الأسعار مع سجلات تدقيق وضوابط يحددها البائع.
• إضافة (plugin) تنقل ذكاء Seller Assistant إلى الأدوات التي يستخدمها البائعون، تبدأ مع Amazon Quick وبنسخة تجريبية مع Claude من Anthropic.
• اشتراك Quick Plus مجاني لمدة 12 شهراً.
• يعمل على Amazon Bedrock.

توضح الخطوة اتجاه Amazon نحو الذكاء الاصطناعي الوكيلي في خدمة البائعين.
